 A highly scalable, highly available, real\\-time advertising platform is critical to support and grow Roku's rapidly expanding ad business.  * Work alongside a highly skilled engineering team to design, develop, and maintain large scale, highly performant, real\\-time applications.
* Own building features, driving directly with product and other engineering teams
* Demonstrate excellent communication skills in working with technical and non\\-technical audiences
* Be an evangelist for best practices across all functions – developers, QA, and infrastructure/ops
* Be an evangelist for platform innovation and reuse
* Deliver top\\-quality software in a timely fashion

 * 8\\+ years of experience building large scale and low latency distributed systems.
* Command of Java or C\\+\\+.
* Solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, performance optimization techniques, object\\-oriented programming, multi\\-threading, and real\\-time programming.
* Experience with distributed caching, SQL/NO SQL, and other databases is a plus.
* Experience with Big Data and cloud services such as AWS/GCP is a plus.
* Experience in advertising domain a big plus
* B.S. or M.S. degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent
* Self\\-motivated individual with a high level of accountability and ownership.
* Critical thinking and practical decision making.
* Can do, results\\-oriented mindset.
* Nonpolitical, collaborative, and team oriented.
* Desire to win in a highly competitive industry.
* AI growth mindset / AI Literacy


  
 
  
 



  
 






**What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?**

 Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.
 



  
 


**What are some of the benefits?** 

 Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.
 



  
 


**Accommodations** 

 Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.
 



  
 


**What should I know about Roku's culture?** 

 Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast\\-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.
 



 We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem\\-solvers, which itself is a two\\-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002\\.
 



 To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

* Mentor other engineers through technical leadership, project ownership, and strong engineering practices \\- including in a "player\\-coach" capacity as the team grows.

* Experience leading technical projects involving multiple contributors, including coordinating work and driving successful execution.
* Strong proactive communication and stakeholder management skills, with high empathy/EQ and the ability to partner deeply with non\\-engineering teams and translate ambiguous or urgent needs into effective technical solutions.
* Excellent engineering judgment and systems thinking \\- able to design scalable architectures, pick the right level of abstraction, and make pragmatic tradeoffs without over\\-building.
* Experience improving or modernizing existing systems, balancing rapid product development with long\\-term platform health.
* Experience building internal tools, workflow systems, or automation for operations\\-heavy teams (or analogous customer\\-embedded roles like FDE/solutions engineering).
* Comfortable operating in fast\\-moving, ambiguous environments where priorities evolve quickly.

title: Go-to-market Engineer
description:
**💚 Who are you?**
 You're a systems thinker first. You look at a sales team and don't see people who need more leads \\- you see a machine that needs better intelligence, cleaner data, and smarter automation to do what it already does, but faster and with far more confidence.
   

  

 You've worked in MOps, RevOps, or a hybrid of both. You know the CRM deeply enough to architect it, not just use it. You've built workflows and automations that actually get adopted. You understand that in a relationship\\-led, enterprise sales environment (which is exactly what selling into the NHS is), the difference between winning and losing often comes down to who walked into the room better prepared.
   

  

 You’ll report to our Growth Marketing Manager, who supports the delivery of our GTM, and who'll point you at the problems that matter most. From there you won't wait to be told how to fix them. You'll form a view, bring a proposal, and build it. Day to day you'll work directly with our BDMs, marketers, and Customer Success team. They're your users, and the role only works if they trust what you build.
   

  

**🩺OK, that’s me, but who are DrDoctor?**
 Take a look at our careers page or our website to find out a bit more about our mission, vision, and impact!
   

  

 But ultimately, we 💚 the NHS and want to help it work better. We radically transform the delivery of health services to make healthcare work for everyone – for patients, doctors, administrative teams and taxpayers.
   

  

 DrDoctor was built on a simple belief: technology can transform the NHS. Our B Corporation certification holds us accountable not just for what we build, but for how we build it \\- and the impact that has on people, patients and the health system around us.
   

  

**☀️What would I be doing day to day?**
 One of the great things about DrDoctor is that every day is different and there is always an opportunity to get involved in something outside of your ‘BAU’ or your regular teams!
   

  

 However, the key things you could expect would include:
   

  

**Commercial intelligence \\- making the team room\\-ready**
 Before every senior event, dinner, or discovery call, the commercial team should walk in knowing exactly who they're meeting, what's changed at that organisation recently, and what to prioritise. You'll build and own the system that makes that happen: enriched stakeholder briefs, exec hire monitoring, board changes, procurement signals. Right now this is done manually and inconsistently. You'll make it repeatable and fast.
   

  

**Attribution \\- Knowing What Actually Works**
 We run our own private events, podcasts, and exhibit at some flagship events. Some move deals. Some don't. Right now we can make educated guesses; you'll build the attribution layer that tells us with confidence which activities are worth the investment \\- and which we should redirect.
   

  

**Signal monitoring across target accounts**
 NHS selling is long\\-cycle and relationship\\-led. The moments that matter \\- a new CDIO joining a trust, an ICB restructure, a published tender, a policy shift \\- often happen weeks before they're visible to the commercial team. You'll monitor for those triggers across our target account list and make sure the right person gets the right nudge at the right time.
   

  

**CRM as a genuine source of truth**
 You'll own the architecture of our HubSpot instance, lifecycle stages, contact and account data quality, deduplication, ownership rules, and automate the hygiene so the team can trust what's in the system and act on it without second\\-guessing, and without anyone cleaning it by hand.
   

  

**Sales enablement automation**
 Auto\\-generated pre\\-meeting briefs. Follow\\-up workflow triggers. Pipeline forecasting. Engagement scoring that flags warm accounts to the right BDM before the moment passes. You'll build and iterate the automations that reduce manual effort and increase the quality and speed of commercial follow\\-up.
   

  

**Campaign and content signal loops**
 We're shifting from lead generation to demand generation, tracking intent signals from content engagement, not just traditional form fills. You'll connect the dots between our marketing campaigns, web signals, and CRM so that a trust reading different content across a specific campaign three times in a week doesn't slip through unnoticed.
   

  

**Owning the GTM stack**
 New tools should arrive here on purpose. You'll evaluate and integrate what the stack needs, whether that's enrichment, intent data, or outbound orchestration, and retire anything that isn't earning its licence. You'll own the tooling. Everything you ship comes with documentation and training, so the team can run it without you.
   

  

**Marketing operations foundations**
 Attribution and demand generation only work if the plumbing underneath is solid. You'll set the standards and automate their enforcement: UTM taxonomy, campaign naming, lifecycle and MQL definitions, lead routing, and the SLAs between Marketing and Sales. You'll also run the marketing automation layer (nurture flows, forms, landing pages, deliverability) and the web tracking that feeds it (GA4, tag management, conversion tracking).
   

  

**Reporting that gets used**
 You'll build the dashboards that show Marketing, Sales, and leadership what's working: funnel, pipeline, campaign ROI. One version of the truth, kept current without anyone having to chase it.
   

  

**Compliance designed in from the start**
 We sell into the NHS and we treat stakeholder data accordingly. Consent capture, preference management, GDPR, PECR, and retention will be built into the enrichment and outbound engines you create, so we can move fast without ending up on the wrong side of the rules.
   

  

**Test, measure, and iterate**
 Not every idea will work, and that's fine. A key part of this role is treating your work as loops: you'll generate ideas independently, put them live, and measure whether they're actually working and having an impact, then keep what does and drop what doesn't. That includes the AI: anything AI\\-generated that reaches a client, whether research, briefs, or personalisation, gets accuracy\\-checked before it scales.
   

  

**🎓OK, I’m interested. What experience do I need to have?**
**Must\\-haves**
* 5–7 years in Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, or a GTM systems role, ideally in B2B SaaS, health tech, or a complex, relationship\\-led sales environment
* You think in systems before you think in tools. You can map a commercial process, identify where it breaks, and design a fix, not just implement one you've been handed
* AI\\-native: you build automated and AI workflows as a matter of course. We're an AI\\-first company and Anthropic is our AI of choice, so direct experience with Claude, and tools like n8n or MCP\\-based integrations, is a strong advantage
* Strong HubSpot experience: workflows, lifecycle stages, reporting, data architecture. You've made a CRM actually useful, not just populated
* Comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, and cross\\-platform integrations. You can write SQL to pull and check your own data, and script in Python or JavaScript when a workflow tool won't cut it. Using AI to write them is fine. That's how we work. You don't need to be a developer, but you must understand code can't be afraid of the plumbing.
* Experience building automations that get adopted. You understand change management is half the job
* Self\\-directed and commercially curious: you'll need to build relationships with Sales, Marketing, and CS and earn the trust to shape how they work
* B2 English (minimum), C1 or higher preferred.


**Nice\\-to\\-haves**
* Familiarity with intent data platforms, enrichment tools (Clay or similar), or warm outbound orchestration.
* Any exposure to NHS, public sector, or regulated\\-industry GTM, understanding how NHS procurement cycles and stakeholder maps work is a genuine edge.
* Experience with call intelligence or revenue intelligence tools (Gong, Chorus, or equivalent).
* Comfortable with meeting recording and transcription tools as part of a modern GTM stack.
* Background in demand generation or ABM programmes.


**This is a hybrid role which requires regular overlap with UK working hours since your manager and most stakeholders are UK based. If you are working from the office, you will be expected to work 10am \\- 7pm along with the rest of the office based team. If you are not working from the office, you will be expected to work UK hours. This is a non negotiable for us so please be sure you can commit to this before applying**
**👑Why this role matters**
 Selling into the NHS is relationship\\-led and long\\-cycle. We can't brute\\-force it with volume, and we don't want to scale demand by adding headcount. This role is how we grow instead: better intelligence, cleaner data, faster follow\\-up. You'll see the effect of your work in pipeline quality and in how prepared the team is when they walk into a room.
   

  

**👑What Success Looks Like**
**30 days:** 
 You've mapped the current GTM stack, identified the three biggest gaps in our commercial intelligence and attribution, and built your first relationships with the Sales, Marketing, and CS teams. You have a point of view on what to fix first.
   

  

**60 days:** 
 At least one meaningful improvement is live and being used, a stakeholder brief workflow, a signal\\-monitoring process, a cleaned CRM segment, or a campaign attribution model. The commercial team has noticed.
   

  

**90 days:** 
 The team is walking into events and meetings better prepared than before you arrived, with the research done for them. Attribution is cleaner. You've automated 5 routine manual tasks that were eating the team's time (we'll agree the exact target together). You have a backlog of improvements you're driving, not waiting on.
   

  

 💡
 **Thinking of applying?**
 We know from research and experience that candidates may not apply if they don’t think they meet 100% of our requirements. If you don’t tick all the boxes but feel you would be a good fit, we would still love to hear from you. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive culture!
   

  

**We’re happy to make reasonable adjustments at any stage of the hiring process and in the role.**
 Just to let you know too, we will need you to have the Right To Work in the UK.
   

  

**🐾We're perfect for each other, what are the next steps** 
 ?
   

  

 We are currently recruiting heavily and have a lot of CVs to go through so please be patient with us while we go through them.
   

  

 If this job looks right for you, please go ahead and apply. If it's a match, we'll set up an initial call with you to find out more about you and your experience, after that you'll meet some more of the team across a few more stages, including a technical/competency interview or task and a culture add interview.
   

  

**🎉I can’t wait to get started, what are the perks?**
 You can find our Perks and Benefits here! We like to think there's something for everyone! We're a social and pretty casual bunch who love to spend time together, virtually and in person.
   

  

 We have social budgets and encourage everyone to organise something that they're interested in, from casual nights at the pub to hiring football pitches, going for Iftar dinner or making your own silver rings, we love a bit of variety!
